title.narrative: Impact of CARITAS contribution to SDGs in coordination with strategic partners

description.narrative: The intervention is aimed at the structural strengthening (internal/external) of the National Caritas in Latin America and the Caribbean so that through 2 processes they can make progress in contributing to the SDGs, especially those related to gender equality, DHIS, Integral Ecology, food security, poverty eradication and migration. These processes include: 1) Promotion of good practices for the SDGs and articulation with strategic actors through the design of intervention strategies and 2) Strategic strengthening as a regional Caritas, which includes an SDG perspective in its action plan, which would allow an improvement in the relationship and interrelation with regional strategic actors for the achievement of the 2030 development agenda, and align the articulation on issues of high regional interest such as those mentioned above. Its implementation is designed for a 2-year period from 1 January 2023 to 31 December 2024, and will ensure sophisticated tools for SDG analysis, which will enable dialogue with multilateral organisations, governments, and other civil society organisations to identify potential actions for articulation. It will incorporate knowledge and skills strengthening actions in the participating Caritas to improve the level of contribution (internal/external) to the SDGs and issues of interest to the teams (Poverty, Multidimensional Poverty, Inequality vs. Inequity, as well as sophisticated tools for decision making for intervention (Social Returns Analysis, Impact Assessment, etc.). The proposal incorporates the use of methodological tools for regional strategic intervention design by updating the strategic plan with an SDG approach, as well as the consolidation of the regional teams and working groups New Economies and Good Living, Migrations, Equity, Advocacy and Communications.
